<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI policy and growth outlook:</strong> The Reserve Bank of India kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25% while maintaining a neutral stance, citing global uncertainty, even as it raised the FY27 growth forecast to 6.7%.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxNeDZGbVNGdlZCbEVfU1RWR3JjV1d3OUNIMExXTm91R21ybzMySlJXNGZiZmZ0MVFVSVRyMWhFMHJ2YkkwZjV1SkllMEV3blo0LWJLSElZZ1pUQWhsb1llZ3VtUzJkY3RfbGI1bjhleV9OM0dGUzV2UUtOdjBNUjhxVXRkcnUzU2QzZncwYzdNc19zX2RWbjl2UUNiRHQ5UG8?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I14</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxNbDVick5UWHZZd1Y1bE5zbW00ZnkwOFowYWpWWXJ2RlFyYmZXbURHUmJrR1ZwNHcwZ3E0QWlQZ2ZkOGZtWTd2Y04ySUpwUURjTlliTFlXeFpxZGxLMDhUT2JtYWZiT0dFNFM4TGhwMHpPbldrbXpOOTlWZGtEWkdLeWFCUWx3Zw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I25</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxNemJaeDhYVXBwc0lXa3FLSmxJcmpsYUVkSVNGWkRPOFYzbFhNNlNIRGlNWkM0VXRlaHJlSXlGY2NSSW1QZ2k1SVluSGZJd0JvX2luT1IzRW9UOWJqS3c3UDB0Y0hyblBrQ2ExQVQyWi1yc3k5MjNLajJMX3RVYzV2VHBxbmFZbVNPemswM0tqTXpicnRZNm00QlhhbjR2a08zb25VUkZNNXNRS3ptc2ZoUzhnemVBZm4zNXg4NnZB?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I36</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Shifting institutional ownership:</strong> Domestic Institutional Investor (DII) holdings in the Nifty-500 have climbed to a record 21%, while Foreign Institutional Investor (FII) ownership has declined to an all-time low of 17%.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.-?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I28</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I29</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Currency and commodity pressure:</strong> The Indian rupee depreciated by 9 paise to 95.17 against the US dollar, though market sentiment remains supported by a softening in global crude oil prices.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>US monetary policy outlook:</strong> Federal Reserve official Mary Daly signaled support for steady rates, emphasizing the need for further inflation data before making decisions for the September meeting.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W4</a></span></li>
</ul>
